t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They think complementary colours have something to do with which colour gnome goes with which coloured basket.

vb_textbox.text: I believe it has something to do with the basket colours. E.g. for a while, always picking the colour gnome that gives you a red basket- like the pink gnome, brown, red- will give you the most mushrooms, then when it stops giving you lots of mushrooms start picking the gnomes that give you the yellow basket until that one also stops giving you lots of mushrooms.
